experiment: N1 coordinate, unit, provenance and intervention contract
scope: Development-only contract validation. No A0 efficacy comparison, no new scene.

alignment.prefix_reason: Existing E0 validation/calibration interval [0,40), chosen independently of oracle effects.
alignment.local_unit_rule: C = prefix_global_alignment_scale * first_KF_Sim3_scale; one fixed C for all KFs

common_mask.definition: baseline native active AND finite GT within range AND not depth edge; frozen before intervention
common_mask.static_scene: Replica synthetic static scene; no separate semantic/sky/dynamic mask
common_mask.visibility_limit: Source-view valid GT and depth-edge exclusion only; no target-view all-arm visibility filtering

subset.selection: fixed source spatial cells and predicted-depth bins within common validity; no GT outlier labels

camera_convention: Existing E0/E1 resize/crop K convention (cx*sx-left, cy*sy-top), no additional half-pixel offset
primary_branch: raw outputs[0] self-branch in first-source/anchor camera
cross_branch: outputs[1] excluded from primary; GT relative-pose conversion is a secondary oracle

tolerances.raw_camera_ray_matching: diagnostic only; do not require predictions to lie on GT-calibrated rays
